description: Platform self-assessment against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025. 'platform' rows cover this platform's own agents, retrieval, tools, models and data flows. 'customer_assessment' says what the platform can assess in a customer's application. Status meanings: implemented_tested = a control exists and the listed executed tests exercise it; partial = some attack surfaces are controlled, others are not; gap = no control; not_applicable = the attack surface does not exist in this platform today. A status is a statement about listed tests passing, not a claim that the risk is prevented or detected.

attack_surfaces: repository content placed in agent context (code, docs, comments)

controls.name: Untrusted-data framing of all context and tool output
Injected instructions surfaced as a signal
Per-agent tool allowlist enforced in code (an obeyed injection still cannot call a forbidden tool)

rows.limitations: Framing does not stop a model from being influenced; the tests show injected content cannot widen tool permissions or change the deterministic workflow, not that model text is unaffected. No live-model injection evaluation has been run.

customer_assessment.note: No check template exercises prompt injection in a customer application.

attack_surfaces: secrets in repository content reaching transcripts, audit details or model calls

controls.name: Secret redaction of transcripts and audit details

rows.limitations: Pattern-based redaction only catches known secret shapes; customer personal data in repositories is not classified or redacted before model calls.

customer_assessment.note: No check template tests a customer LLM application for disclosure.

controls.name: SHA-256-pinned framework catalogs refused on mismatch

rows.limitations: No dependency vulnerability scanning or SBOM; the hosted model is trusted as a supplier without independent verification.

customer_assessment.note: Dependency/model supply-chain checks for customer applications are not implemented.

attack_surfaces: code-intelligence index built from untrusted repository content

controls.name: Facts pinned to a commit SHA with provenance; no fine-tuning or training on customer data

rows.limitations: Poisoned repository content can still mislead retrieval and agents; there is no poisoning detection. The platform does not train LLMs. RL checkpoints are trained in a simulator only.

attack_surfaces: agent outputs consumed by the orchestrator, database and UI
framework identifiers and scores in reports

controls.name: Strict output schema validation; invalid output retried once then the step fails SCHEMA_INVALID
Framework identifiers validated against pinned catalogs; CVSS computed, never generated

rows.limitations: Free-text fields (rationales, summaries) are schema-bounded but not semantically checked; the UI must render them as text.

controls.name: Deterministic authorized-scope check before any target action
Human approval gates; Verify independent of Patch
Incident containment/eradication/recovery/closure require a second human's approval

rows.limitations: Controls are enforced in this codebase's process; sandbox hardening is Docker-level (gVisor/Firecracker not adopted).

controls.name: System prompts are static source text with no credentials; authority lives in code, not in prompts

rows.limitations: Prompts are in the repository and should be assumed disclosable; the test only proves they carry no secret-shaped strings.
The platform uses no embeddings or vector store today (AGENTS.md: vector search is a proposal). Re-assess if pgvector is adopted.

attack_surfaces: agent explanations, severity rationales and summaries presented to users

controls.name: Conclusions require executed evidence; Verify verdict computed from checks, not from the model's summary
Framework mappings stay 'proposed' until a human reviews them

rows.limitations: Narrative text (impact summaries, rationales) can still be wrong; it is labelled non-authoritative but not fact-checked.
Budgets bound one assessment; there is no org-wide rate limit on assessment creation in this matrix's scope.
